from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import SPSA
from qiskit_algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_docplex_mp
from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import MinimumEigenOptimizer
from qiskit_optimization.applications import Maxcut
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_networkx
import networkx as nx

def solve_mis_qaoa(graph_vertices, graph_edges, optimal_independent_set_size, p_layers=3, penalty=3.0, opt_shots=1024, final_shots=4096, maxiter=120, seed=42):
    # Create a NetworkX graph
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)
    
    # Convert the graph to a quadratic program
    qp = from_networkx(G, Maxcut)
    
    # Convert the quadratic program to a QUBO problem
    qubo = QuadraticProgramToQubo(penalty=penalty)
    qubo_problem = qubo.convert(qp)
    
    # Set up the QAOA solver
    optimizer = SPSA(maxiter=maxiter, max_trials=maxiter*2)
    backend = AerSimulator(seed_simulator=seed)
    qaoa = QAOA(backend=backend, optimizer=optimizer, p=p_layers)
    
    # Set up the optimizer
    meo = MinimumEigenOptimizer(qaoa)
    
    # Solve the QUBO problem
    result = meo.solve(qubo_problem)
    
    # Extract the solution
    solution = result.samples[0].x
    independent_set = [vertex for vertex, bit in zip(graph_vertices, solution) if bit == 1]
    independent_set_ratio = len(independent_set) / len(graph_vertices)
    
    # Check validity
    valid = all(G.has_edge(u, v) for u, v in zip(independent_set, independent_set[1:]))
    validity_rate = float(valid)
    
    # Calculate embedding overhead and resource cost
    embedding_overhead = 1.0  # Placeholder for actual overhead calculation
    resource_cost = p_layers * len(graph_vertices)  # Placeholder for actual cost calculation
    
    return {
        "independent_set_ratio": independent_set_ratio,
        "validity_rate": validity_rate,
        "embedding_overhead": embedding_overhead,
        "resource_cost": resource_cost
    }
